name: lv_obj_set_local_style_prop

provenance.source: Exact xiaomi-band-9-pro-3.1.190 image: the body is the same four-step sequence as the 3.1.32 setter (get the local style for the selector, lv_style_set_prop, refresh the style), and sub_C4CF19C is a wrapper that calls it with property 9. The earlier record 0xc23afe2 is a two-call position/size setter, not this function.

notes: LVGL v8 local-style setter (obj, property, value, selector). Style table ids on 3.1.190 are (type<<16 | property): radius 11, bg_color 32, bg_opa 33, pad_top..pad_right 16..19, x 7, border_width 50, text_color 85, text_font 87, text_align 91. Not device probed.
